378.title: Fale sobre você — suas obrigações fiscais
378.note: Perguntas sobre o dia a dia do aluno. Se travar, ofereça a estrutura-modelo e peça para completar.

items.q: What tax must your company pay?
What do you have to file every year?
items.a: I have to file ___ every year.

items.q: What deadline must you never miss?
items.a: I must never miss the ___ deadline.

items.q: What do you have to collect on sales?
items.a: I have to collect ___ on sales.

items.q: What must you keep for the tax office?
What happens if you pay late?
items.a: If I pay late, I have to ___ .

379.title: Exercício extra A — Complete com because / so / therefore (accounting)
379.note: Faça oralmente. Conectivos de causa e resultado.

items.q: Product A is losing money, ___ we should review it.
Cash is tight this month; ___ we will delay the purchase.
We cut prices ___ the market was weak.
Sales fell, ___ we lowered the forecast.
The margin is low; ___ we must raise prices.
We kept the client ___ the relationship is important.
Costs went up, ___ the profit went down.
The report was clear; ___ the decision was easy.
We invested in storage ___ demand was growing.
The data was strong, ___ we pushed the product.

379.title: Exercício extra B — Junte causa e resultado
379.note: Modelo: Product A loses money. / We review it. → Product A loses money, so we review it.

items.q: Cash is tight. / We delay the purchase.
items.a: Cash is tight; therefore, we delay the purchase.

items.q: Sales fell. / We lowered the forecast.
items.a: Sales fell, so we lowered the forecast.

items.q: The market was weak. / We cut prices.
items.a: We cut prices because the market was weak.

items.q: The margin is low. / We must raise prices.
items.a: The margin is low; therefore, we must raise prices.

items.q: Demand was growing. / We invested in storage.
items.a: We invested in storage because demand was growing.

380.title: Exercício extra A — Complete no present simple (sistemas e regras) (accounting)
380.note: Faça oralmente. Regras de auditoria e controles internos.

items.q: Separation of duties ___ (reduce) the risk of fraud.
The audit trail ___ (show) who did what.
Honest controls ___ (build) trust with the bank.

380.title: Exercício extra B — Vire negativa e pergunta no present simple
380.note: Modelo: Auditors check the books. → Auditors do not check the books. / Do auditors check the books?

items.a: Two signatures do not (don't) protect every payment. / Do two signatures protect every payment?
An internal control does not (doesn't) prevent fraud. / Does an internal control prevent fraud?
The auditor does not (doesn't) work independently. / Does the auditor work independently?
Reconciliation does not (doesn't) catch errors. / Does reconciliation catch errors?

items.q: The audit trail shows every change.
items.a: The audit trail does not (doesn't) show every change. / Does the audit trail show every change?
